title: Custom Tube to Tube transfer
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package containing the custom labware definitions for the reservoir and plate, then upload the labware definition file in the OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the source 24‑tube rack (6 × 4) in Slot 1, the destination 6 × 5 tube rack in Slot 2, and the Opentrons 1000 µL filter tip rack in Slot 3.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the customizations field, specify the Number of Samples (how many source tubes to transfer), Delay Time after Aspirating (seconds, 0 or more), Aspiration Height for Recipient tube (mm), Dispense Height for Recipient tube (mm), and the mount side for the P1000 Single‑GEN2 pipette.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, calibrate the tip rack, source rack, destination rack, and the P1000 Single‑GEN2 pipette according to the provided support articles.

steps.title: Transfer 500 µL with fresh tip
steps.instruction: For each sample, follow column order in the source rack and row order in the destination rack (start a new row after each column):

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new 1000 µL filter tip.
Aspirate 500 µL from the source tube at the specified aspiration height.
Wait the specified delay time after aspiration.
Dispense 500 µL into the destination tube at the specified dispense height.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to execute the programmed transfers.
